strings.new:
Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash.

Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters.

Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage.

Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.

Apply vapors to you or an ally. While it lasts they act faster and taking damage rips a specter from their body, delaying the damage. Healing exorcises the specters, removing them.

When the vapors wear off they act slower and the remaining specters deal the delayed damage plus extra damage over {s:CrashDuration}s.

Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'} to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities. At max terror, they flee in fear away from you.

Each leech you have collected adds fear duration.

Enemies facing away from you take {s:FacingAwayDamagePercent}% damage unless feared.

-{s:SlowPercent}% Move Speed and Fire Rate
+{s:DPS} DPS

+{s:AbilityChannelTime}s Channel Time
+{s:DPS_scale} Spirit Scaling
Immune to damage while channeling

Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Heal'} allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them.

Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip.

Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.

+{s:HealRegen_scale} Spirit Scaling
Shots extend non-ultimate buff durations by {s:BuffExtendPercentPerShot}%, up to their max duration
Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'} and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs.

Harrow can pick up leeches after they finish feeding, {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Healing'} her for the health drained and permanently granting {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Regen'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'FireRate'}.

25% of your leech stacks are lost on death.
Leeches drain stamina and restore it to you on pickup

+{s:Radius}m Radius
+{s:DPS_scale} Spirit Scaling
+{s:MaxLeechBonusStacks} Max Leech Stacks

A respected pillar at the Marble Hill Possession Ward, Nurse Harrow has dedicated her life to combating the horrors of supernatural possession. A blend of care, severity, and detached pragmatism; Harrow has been called a saint by some of her patients, and a cruel governess by others. Both are probably true.

But while any sane person would question how and why Harrow keeps the pain of her patients stored in her medical bag,  none can question the results of her treatment program... cruel though it may be.

Kind of enjoyed smacking the judgment off her face.
She had it out for me, I could tell.
Glad my parents never heard of her.
I don't even want to know what's in that bag.
You work in the Possession Ward, right?
We haven't, my friend was a patient of yours when he was kid.
Oh, it was a while ago, you probably wouldn't -
You remind me of one of my professors at Jamie West.
That's a little more bitchy than I was expecting.
Check out what The Nurse bought.
That bag really pulls the gaze.
You can feel her judging you, can't you?
Good, good, I made her look more professional than murderous.
I'd probably trust that face to attend to me.
Her gaze makes me want to stand up straight.
Go back to whatever creepy hospital you came out of.
Hate to see that lady work with kids.
Yeah, I don't think I need any of her tender care.
Ugh. She reminds me of Mildred.
Keep that bag away from me, Harrow.
Should have stayed in your own neighborhood.
Don't talk to me like I'm child
You better not try to boss me around.
She did not like that at all.
Your services are no longer needed.
You're messing with some serious magic.
What do you do with all that pain you siphon off your patients?
You're not gonna have that bag forever, Harrow.
Your bedside manner needs a lot of work.
You know that just makes me want to steal it right?
Planning?  Lady I'm going to steal it.
I bet you're fun at parties
And why would we do that?
That's noble of you Harrow.  Sadly, it's not up to me
Check out what Nurse Harrow bought.
Not even the mightiest of healers, can withstand the Chimera Mark 1!
Now on the battlefield, is attacking soft targets like nurses a war crime? That's for wiser men to decide.
Nurse Harrow, it's not your fault the undead and healers have fought for generations. Who knows how it started? All I know that I am not the one to bridge the generational divide.
Is she a stern governess? Is she a demonic healer? The answer is dead, and that’s thanks to the Chimera Mark 1!
A wise man once said \"physician heal thyself\" but even the Nazarene know  there's some wounds you cannot heal.
Miss, now you look like a hard working medical professional
Now what if I told you that Fairfax Industries was ready to revolutionize the possessed child industry?  Would you be interested or extremely interested?
Miss, the modern world does not walk it runs.  And here in the 20th century your options are either to be the finest horse and buggy coachman and be unemployed, or to learn to love the automobile.
I belong to nobody, but god do I love what I do
I don't think she wants to be friends.
She should get a pillow instead of that bag.
